{{Top|leg}}
The '''Junction 5 Guardians''' was an organization formed by the government of [[Junction V|Junction 5]] to defend against an invasion from [[Delaluna]] or an attack by the Annihilator. In the end, both threats were a ruse intended to destroy the liberties of the citizens of Junction 5.
